subject: PVE of QTL excluding interaction from fitqtl output

messages.author: bb6cce4079fc308e
messages.subject: PVE of QTL excluding interaction from fitqtl output
parts:
Dear Karl and r/qtl users,

I have a question about estimating PVE for QTLs of additive effect only using the fitqtl command. Considering a full MQM, which is Q1+Q2+Q1:Q2 (there is interaction between Q1 + Q2), the results of dropone anova table by fitqtl is below:

                       var(%)
-------------------------------------
Total               Vtotal
Q1                   V1
Q2                   V2
Q1:Q2             V3

As far as I know, V1 and V2 includes the effect of the interaction between Q1 and Q2. If I am only interested in how much variance Q1 alone explaned ,excluding the interaction between Q1 and Q2, should it be equal to V1-V3?

Thank you in advance!

Best,
Ivan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] PVE of QTL excluding interaction from fitqtl output
parts:
Yes, I guess you could subtract V1-V3 and call it the main effect variance due to QTL 1, but I'm not totally comfortable with it. View it as a rough guide, and with considerable skepticism.

These estimated variances are coming from a transformation of the difference in LOD scores. With complete genotype information at the QTL, this does work, but with any amount of incomplete genotype information it could be a very rough approximation.

karl
